scientific_limitations_integrity: The theorem gives logarithmic but not ordinary density. General k-base families require rational independence of reciprocal logarithms; pairwise irrational ratios alone are not settled for k>=3. Classical Weyl and Gelfond--Schneider theorems are cited, not newly proved. Independent audit and publication priority not established.
title: Logarithmic race laws and arbitrary-length orderings of palindromic numeral counts
